title: Q4 close with two years of flat growth
description: Brightwell Analytics is closing the fourth quarter and must prepare the quarterly report, but ARR has been flat for two years and nobody has growth ideas. Two concrete levers appear: a time-limited co-sell offer from a telematics partner and a renewal at risk with the largest customer. A market report is then corrected and the partner revises its offer.

pieces.brief: Marcus Hale (CEO) writes to Tom Alvarez, copying Priya Raman: growth has been flat for two years, ARR is $47.3M, and there are no new ideas on the table. He needs concrete growth options for the quarterly report before the close. Calm but pressing, brief, signed Marcus. No other numbers.
pieces.example:
Tom,

Growth has been flat for two years: ARR is $47.3M and we have no new ideas on the table. I need concrete options for the quarterly report before the close.

Marcus

pieces.brief: Ray Whitcomb (Hollis Freight procurement) writes bluntly to Jenna Okafor, copying Priya Raman: Hollis will consider renewing only with a 15% discount on the annual fee, and wants the proposal by January 15, 2027. No pleasantries, short, signed with name and company. No other numbers.

Jenna,

We will consider renewing only with a 15% discount on the annual fee. Send your proposal by January 15, 2027.

Ray Whitcomb
